name: 25h-agent-kit
description: Eight small Claude Code plugins for the failures that repeat: keys, plans, handoffs, and time.

plugins.name: install-gate
plugins.description: Checks for an audit record before Claude installs a tool machine-wide: no record blocks, LOW passes, MID or HIGH asks you. Includes a skill that writes the record.

plugins.name: secret-guard
plugins.description: Blocks tool calls that contain key-shaped strings before they run, and redacts keys from the output of successful Bash commands before Claude receives it.

plugins.name: time-guard
plugins.description: Gives Claude the current local date and time from the system clock on every prompt, and adds a note when Claude writes time wording that has no clock time or date next to it.

plugins.name: plan-review
plugins.description: Sends a finished plan to two independent reviewers that have not seen the conversation, then rules on every finding and records the rulings in the plan file.

plugins.name: root-fix
plugins.description: When the same mistake keeps coming back: trace it to its source, fix that one point, sweep for siblings of the same defect, and add a check that would catch the next occurrence.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Turns the work left at the end of a session into instructions that the next session can run with no prior context: stop conditions a command can confirm, and a re-check of the premises before anything else.

plugins.name: session-memory
plugins.description: Injects a thin snapshot of where the work stands at session start, and provides two skills: one writes the daily record at the end of a session, one builds a single morning page.

plugins.name: judgment-index
plugins.description: An index of judgment criteria kept in the repository. With its one line in CLAUDE.md, Claude looks the scene up before asking a person whether it may do something, reads one row, and adds a row when none exists.
